## Job queue review **Races:** - Duplicate job IDs accepted twice - Job claimed by two workers (no atomic claim) - Result written after job marked failed **Cancellation:** - Cancel flag checked only at job start - Long HTTP call ignores cancel - Cancel does not release locks/resources **Backpressure:** - Unbounded queue memory growth - No max in-flight per worker - No retry cap → thundering herd **Hardening:** - Atomic claim (DB row lock / unique claim token) - Idempotency keys - Cancellation checked at safe points + context timeouts - Bounded queue + reject policy - Dead-letter queue for poison jobs - Metrics: queue depth, p95 latency, failure rate, retry rate **Tests:** duplicate submit, crash between claim and complete, cancel mid-job, poison job, queue full. Prefer at-least-once + idempotent workers over fragile exactly-once. Document delivery semantics.
